mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering a negative feedback loop in corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (above 2% annualized), supply chain bottlenecks ease, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 2% annualized, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC for CPI threshold signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC for PAYEMS signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in retail sales (RSAFS) falls below 1.0%, it signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS YoY < 1.0%, or Rank IC for RSAFS threshold signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates improving supply chain efficiency and stronger manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
